_readme: Per-locale reel captions + tagline. gen_scenes.py stamps these into scenes_<locale>.json,
reusing the English scenes.json for timing, canvas and style — only the words change.
Reel captions are even tighter than screenshot captions: they sit in a 22% caption band over
a moving frame and are on screen for 4-5 seconds. A line that wraps to three lines is unreadable
at that speed, so these are rewritten per language rather than translated.
The tagline is the outro card under the app icon. 'Earth Around' itself is never translated.
Audio beds are language-agnostic and are NOT regenerated per locale — the same scored bed is
muxed into every locale's preview, so no existing bed is ever overwritten.
